Title: vlad tepes and what exactly "using" cards entails

Messages.Author: d-mohn
Messages.Body:
so I understand how playing a card as if you met the requirements works thanks to the topics on mata-hari, but how does using work exactly.

Vlad Tepes. Clan: Tzimisce Group: 3 Capacity: 10 aus ANI DOM PRO THA VIC
Independent: Vlad can play and use cards requiring a title or a sect as if he had that title or were of that sect. +1 bleed.

I know for example that he can become an abbot due to his ability to play the card as if he met the sect requirement, does his ability then meet the requirement of "this sabbat vampire gain +1 intercept against D actions" or is that not how "using" a card works.

Abbot -- Type: Action -- Cost: None
+1 stealth action. Requires a Sabbat vampire.
Put this card on this acting Sabbat vampire and unlock him or her. This Sabbat vampire gets +1 intercept against  actions directed at his or her controller. A vampire may have only one Abbot.

if this is how it works, then is "this X vampire gains Y or does Y" the template for using something?

would appreciate some clarification.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> d-mohn wrote:
> I know for example that he can become an abbot due to his ability to play the card as if he met the sect requirement, does his ability then meet the requirement of "this sabbat vampire gain +1 intercept against D actions" or is that not how "using" a card works.
>
He gets +1 intercept against  against with an Abbot because the card requires a Sabbat vampire and sees Vlad as a Sabbat vampire for that matter.
